quality.scale: linear camera RGB, no WB, matrix, clipping, denoise or tone curve
quality.aggregation: sum squared error / sample count by category, split and phase; publish aggregate and worst phase; border separately
promotion_requires: all synthetic gates on development and held-out validation
measured sites exact and finite extended float on all 36 phases
quality.holdout_policy: Do not tune a submitted candidate after inspecting validation. A later candidate requires a new independent holdout.

codec.timed_scope: unpack only including output allocation; source in memory; parse, comparisons and hash excluded
codec.thermal_control: not controlled; record machine, OS, load and thermal observation; no universal latency claim
codec.corpus_diversity: Repeated timing of one RAF is still one photographic case
